# REST API

<!-- Generated by `make generate-docs-api` from the backend's OpenAPI
schema. Do not edit by hand: `make check-docs-api` fails on any change. -->

The web app, the desktop app and the phone app all use this API, and you
can call it from your own scripts. Every route lives under `/api` on the
same address as the web app.

Except for `/api/health` and the sign-in routes under `/api/auth`, every
request needs an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. The token is either
the access token returned by `POST /api/auth/login`, or a personal API token
created in **Settings** (it starts with `cbm_pat_`). Agents usually connect
through [MCP](../agents/index.md) instead.

Schema version 0.1.0.

## Account

The signed-in account: its password and its sign-in provider link.

### `GET /api/account/identity`

Get own identity

Returns: [`AccountIdentityResponse`](#accountidentityresponse)

### `DELETE /api/account/identity`

Unlink own identity

### `POST /api/account/password`

Change own password

Request body: `application/json` ([`ChangePasswordRequest`](#changepasswordrequest))

Returns: [`LoginResponse`](#loginresponse)

## Accounts

Every account on the server. Admins only.

### `GET /api/accounts`

List accounts

Returns: array of [`AccountSummary`](#accountsummary)

### `POST /api/accounts/{account_id}/deactivate`

Deactivate account

| Parameter | In | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | path | yes | integer |

## Attachments

Images embedded in notes.

### `POST /api/attachments`

Upload attachment

| Parameter | In | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `note_path` | query | yes | string |

Returns: [`AttachmentUploadResponse`](#attachmentuploadresponse)

### `GET /api/attachments/find`

Find attachment

| Parameter | In | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | query | yes | string |
| `from` | query | no | string |

Returns: [`AttachmentLocation`](#attachmentlocation)

### `GET /api/attachments/{path}`

Get attachment

| Parameter | In | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | path | yes | string |

Returns: any

## Auth

Signing in, registering with an invite, and refreshing a session.

### `POST /api/auth/login`

Login

Request body: `application/json` ([`LoginRequest`](#loginrequest))

Returns: [`LoginResponse`](#loginresponse)

### `GET /api/auth/methods`

Auth methods

Returns: [`AuthMethodsResponse`](#authmethodsresponse)

### `GET /api/auth/oidc/callback`

Callback

| Parameter | In | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | query | no | string or null |
| `state` | query | no | string or null |
| `error` | query | no | string or null |

### `POST /api/auth/oidc/start`

Start

Request body: `application/json` ([`OidcStartRequest`](#oidcstartrequest))

Returns: [`OidcStartResponse`](#oidcstartresponse)

### `POST /api/auth/refresh`

Refresh

Returns: [`LoginResponse`](#loginresponse)

### `POST /api/auth/register`

Register

Request body: `application/json` ([`RegisterRequest`](#registerrequest))

## Graph

The link graph between notes.

### `GET /api/graph`

Graph

Returns: [`GraphResponse`](#graphresponse)

## Health

Whether the server and its vault are up. Needs no token.

### `GET /api/health`

Health check

Returns: map of string

## Invites

Invite tokens for new accounts. Admins only.

### `POST /api/invites`

Create invite

## Notes

Read, create, update, move and delete notes, and list backlinks.

### `GET /api/notes`

List all notes

Returns: array of [`NoteMeta`](#notemeta)

### `GET /api/notes/{path}`

Get note

| Parameter | In | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | path | yes | string |

Returns: [`Note`](#note)

### `PUT /api/notes/{path}`

Put note

| Parameter | In | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | path | yes | string |

Returns: [`Note`](#note)

### `DELETE /api/notes/{path}`

Delete note

| Parameter | In | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | path | yes | string |

### `GET /api/notes/{path}/backlinks`

Backlinks

| Parameter | In | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | path | yes | string |

Returns: array of [`NoteMeta`](#notemeta)

### `POST /api/notes/{path}/move`

Move note

| Parameter | In | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | path | yes | string |

Request body: `application/json` ([`MoveNoteRequest`](#movenoterequest))

Returns: [`Note`](#note)

## Search

Full-text search with the `#tag` syntax described in [Tags and search](../features/index.md).

### `GET /api/search`

Search

| Parameter | In | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | query | no | string |

Returns: array of [`NoteMeta`](#notemeta)

## Tasks

Tasks collected from every note.

### `GET /api/tasks`

Tasks

Returns: array of [`TaskItem`](#taskitem)

## Tokens

Personal API tokens for scripts and MCP clients.

### `GET /api/tokens`

List tokens

Returns: array of [`ApiTokenMeta`](#apitokenmeta)

### `POST /api/tokens`

Create token

Request body: `application/json` ([`CreateApiTokenRequest`](#createapitokenrequest))

### `DELETE /api/tokens/{token_id}`

Delete token

| Parameter | In | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token_id` | path | yes | integer |

## Vault settings

The vault's folder conventions, link format and read-only flag.

### `GET /api/vault-settings`

Get vault settings

Returns: [`VaultSettings`](#vaultsettings)
